pricing_and_rules.link_sms_unit: Higher link tier ($0.12 - $0.14 dynamic from cfg)

step_1_numbers.name: Numbers & Contacts
step_1_numbers.code_prompt: When numbers lack country prefix: Prompt 'Add +1 to N numbers without country code?' or skip.

validation_summary_card.display: Grid of pills showing Sendable, Skipped Landlines, Invalid, Duplicates, and Opted-out counts
validation_summary_card.save_list_checkbox: Optional 'Save as contact list' with name field

step_2_message.name: Message & Screening
fields: Message textarea with live character counter, GSM-7 segment indicator, and live price estimation
Opt-out line switch: 'Reply STOP to opt out' (appends compliance text to segment calculations)
Link & scam detector: Instant inline screening displaying link fee elevation or flagging high-risk words
Consent confirmation checkbox: 'I confirm every recipient consented to receive SMS messages from our business' (Mandatory 428 gate)

step_3_test.name: Test & Deliverability
step_3_test.description: Optional deliverability test text to personal mobile number (First test free, subsequent require wallet funds)

feedback_gate.smart_remediation: If spam/no: query AI tips API to display highlighted risky words and generate 1-click 'Use safer rewrite' suggestion.

step_4_schedule_and_pay.name: Schedule & Pay
options: Send later today (select next hour slot)
Schedule future date & time (calendar datepicker + hourly capacity slot selector; shows 10% discount badge when 24h+ ahead)
step_4_schedule_and_pay.forwarding_toggle: Enable Replies Forwarding (+$20 fee): opens 2-way inbox thread with inbound notifications

booking_summary.payment: WalletPay component with wallet debit, credit/card (Mollie), and crypto fallback.

single_text_and_review_ux.composer: To (+1 USA/Canada number) + message input + opt-out footer toggle
single_text_and_review_ux.cost_badge: Free test remaining OR $1.00 each (Requires min $20 wallet balance)

review_gate_card.title: Did your text to [Number] arrive?
review_gate_card.rating: 1 to 5 stars selection + optional feedback comment
review_gate_card.enforcement: Further single texts remain blocked until review is submitted. High frequency usage displays a nudge advising bulk campaigns for cheaper rates.

system_states.empty: Empty state with Megaphone / MessageSquare icon, helpful explanation of SMS pool, and 'Create First Campaign' CTA
system_states.loading: SkeletonRows and SkeletonPage components matching CloudIVR theme
system_states.errors: ErrorNote with inline retry button and 402 wallet deposit redirect
system_states.quiet_hours: Banner notification: 'Quiet hours in effect (9:00 PM - 8:00 AM recipient local time). Messages will queue and resume at 8:00 AM.'
system_states.pool_unavailable: Warning banner: 'SMS number pool is undergoing routine carrier sync. Scheduling remains open.'

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement /app/frontend/src/cloudivr/pages/BulkSms.js matching existing CloudIVR theme tokens and civr-* styling exactly.

Wire frontend hooks directly to existing backend endpoints (/bulksms, /bulksms/contacts, /bulksms/content, /bulksms/campaigns, /bulksms/campaigns/:id/test, /bulksms/campaigns/:id/when, /bulksms/campaigns/:id/book, /bulksms/bookings/:id/pay, /bulksms/reviews/:id, /bulksms/send-one, /bulksms/conversations).
Adhere strictly to anti-abuse guidelines: gate single text continuation behind positive review completion, and display bulk redirection notice upon heavy single-text volume.
Do not introduce unstyled HTML select or input tags; use civr-input and consistent Lucide React icons.
Ensure every interactive button, input, tab, and card status element is assigned the matching data-testid from the data_testid_manifest.
